fields.authority: Financial Supervisory Authority of Northmark (market surveillance authority for AI used by financial institutions)

system.name: Harbor Credit Assess
system.intendedPurpose: Evaluates the creditworthiness of consumer loan applicants (high-risk use, AI Act Annex III, point 5(b))

fields.description: After a data update on February 2, the system scored applicants from two postal areas markedly lower than comparable applicants elsewhere, and their applications were declined.
fields.harm: 214 applicants were declined on the affected scores; possible infringement of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights (non-discrimination). No death or harm to health.

causalLink.basis: Score logs show the shift in each affected decision; the data update on February 2 is the only change in the period.

fields.parallelReports: National equality body informed on February 10.
correctiveActions: Scores from the February 2 update withdrawn on February 9; the earlier version restored
Declined applications from the period queued for human review
fields.clockStated: 15 days after awareness (scenario clock: EU AI Act Article 73)
fields.status: Investigation open; report will be updated
